[#hash-choose-table]
[cols="3,3,2,2,2",options="header"]
|===
| I need to ... | Use | Its backends: the Jamfile names | Backend | Example

| check that a file or message was not changed by accident or on the way
| <<hash-sha2,sha2_256 (or blake3 for large data)>>
| `hash2`: `/webcpp/hash//hash`
| none: one backend
| `example/sha256.cpp`

| name content by what it holds (a file-sharing app, a cache, a store of blobs)
| <<hash-p2p-content,blake3>>
| `blake3`: `/third_party//blake3`
| link /third_party//blake3
| `example/content_address.cpp`

| prove a message comes from someone who holds a shared secret key (an API request, a cookie, a webhook)
| <<hash-hmac,hmac_sha2_256, checked with webcpp::crypto::constant_time_equal>>
| `hash2`: `/webcpp/hash//hash`
| none: one backend
| `example/hmac_sha256.cpp`

| store users' passwords for a login
| <<hash-privacy-passwords,argon2id with argon2id_interactive or stronger, a random 16-byte salt per user>>
| `sodium`: `/third_party//sodium`, `openssl`: `/webcpp/hash//openssl`, `botan` (with exceptions only): `/third_party//botan`
| link /third_party//sodium
| `example/password_storage.cpp`

| turn a password into an encryption key (a password manager, an encrypted backup)
| <<hash-argon2id,argon2id with argon2id_moderate or argon2id_sensitive, then hkdf for each purpose>>
| `sodium`: `/third_party//sodium`, `openssl`: `/webcpp/hash//openssl`, `botan` (with exceptions only): `/third_party//botan`
| link /third_party//sodium
| `example/argon2id.cpp`

| check or make the bcrypt strings a system already stores, or read and write OpenSSH's encrypted private keys
| <<hash-bcrypt,bcrypt and bcrypt_verify at a cost of 10 or more (bcrypt_pbkdf for OpenSSH's keys); argon2id for a new design>>
| `botan` (with exceptions only): `/third_party//botan`
| name backends::botan and link /third_party//botan, with exceptions
| `example/bcrypt.cpp`

| turn a shared secret (an ECDH result) into keys
| <<hash-hkdf,hkdf over hmac_sha2_256, one application_info label per key>>
| `hash2`: `/webcpp/hash//hash`, `sodium`: `/third_party//sodium`, `bearssl`: `/third_party//bearssl`, `openssl`: `/webcpp/hash//openssl`, `botan` (with exceptions only): `/third_party//botan`, `webcrypto` (asynchronous family only): `/webcpp/asio//asio`
| the default; name a backend only to match another program's
| `example/hkdf.cpp`

| derive the key JOSE's ECDH-ES (a JWE) or another NIST SP 800-56C protocol derives from a shared secret
| <<hash-sskdf,sskdf over digests::sha2_256, the fixed info as the protocol writes it>>
| `openssl`: `/webcpp/hash//openssl`, `botan` (with exceptions only): `/third_party//botan`
| name backends::openssl (or backends::botan) and link its library, /webcpp/hash//openssl (or /third_party//botan)
| `example/sskdf.cpp`

| derive the keys of ECIES or of a smart card's key agreement (ANSI X9.63)
| <<hash-x963kdf,x963kdf over digests::sha2_256, the shared info as the scheme writes it>>
| `openssl`: `/webcpp/hash//openssl`, `botan` (with exceptions only): `/third_party//botan`
| name backends::openssl (or backends::botan) and link its library, /webcpp/hash//openssl (or /third_party//botan)
| `example/x963kdf.cpp`

| derive keys from a key as NIST SP 800-108 or Kerberos does (a label and a context)
| <<hash-kbkdf,kbkdf over hmac_sha2_256 with the label and the context>>
| `openssl`: `/webcpp/hash//openssl`, `botan` (with exceptions only): `/third_party//botan`
| name backends::openssl (or backends::botan) and link its library, /webcpp/hash//openssl (or /third_party//botan)
| `example/kbkdf.cpp`

| derive many keys from one master key, one per purpose
| <<hash-privacy-subkeys,hkdf_expand (or hkdf) with distinct application_info labels, blake2b_subkey (libsodium's crypto_kdf) by id, or blake3::derive_key with a context string>>
| `hash2`: `/webcpp/hash//hash`, `sodium`: `/third_party//sodium`, `openssl`: `/webcpp/hash//openssl`, `botan` (with exceptions only): `/third_party//botan`, `webcrypto` (asynchronous family only): `/webcpp/asio//asio`
| the default
| `example/subkeys.cpp`

| build a hash table, set or Bloom filter whose keys come from the network
| <<hash-siphash,siphash_64 keyed with 16 random bytes per process>>
| `hash2`: `/webcpp/hash//hash`
| none: one backend
| `example/siphash.cpp`

| build a hash table of my own trusted keys, or a fast checksum
| <<hash-non-cryptographic-functions,xxh3_128 or fnv1a_64>>
| `hash2`: `/webcpp/hash//hash`
| none: one backend
| `example/checksums.cpp`

| compute a Bitcoin wallet's BIP39 seed from its words
| <<hash-crypto-bip39,pbkdf2 over hmac_sha2_512, 2,048 iterations (a domain library's step)>>
| `hash2`: `/webcpp/hash//hash`, `openssl`: `/webcpp/hash//openssl`, `botan` (with exceptions only): `/third_party//botan`, `webcrypto` (asynchronous family only): `/webcpp/asio//asio`
| the default
| `example/bip39_seed.cpp`

| compute a Bitcoin address's hash160
| <<hash-crypto-hash160,ripemd_160 over sha2_256 (a domain library's step)>>
| `hash2`: `/webcpp/hash//hash`
| none: one backend
| `example/bitcoin_hash160.cpp`

| compute an Ethereum address or a Solidity selector
| <<hash-crypto-ethereum,keccak_256 (never sha3_256)>>
| `xkcp`: `/third_party//xkcp`
| link /third_party//xkcp
| `example/ethereum_address.cpp`

| compute a Nostr event id
| <<hash-p2p-nostr,sha2_256 over NIP-01's serialization (a domain library's step)>>
| `hash2`: `/webcpp/hash//hash`
| none: one backend
| `example/nostr_event_id.cpp`

| derive NIP-44's conversation key
| <<hash-p2p-nip44,hkdf_extract over hmac_sha2_256 with the salt nip44-v2 (a domain library's step)>>
| `hash2`: `/webcpp/hash//hash`, `sodium`: `/third_party//sodium`, `openssl`: `/webcpp/hash//openssl`, `botan` (with exceptions only): `/third_party//botan`, `webcrypto` (asynchronous family only): `/webcpp/asio//asio`
| the default
| `example/nip44_conversation_key.cpp`

| draw a long stream of pseudorandom bytes from a seed
| <<hash-sha3,shake_128 or shake_256, or blake3's squeeze>>
| `hash2`: `/webcpp/hash//hash`
| none: one backend
| `example/sha3_shake.cpp`

| build the smallest WebAssembly program
| <<hash-default-backend,the default backend, backends::hash2, header-only, and link only the libraries the program uses>>
| `hash2`: `/webcpp/hash//hash`, `sodium`: `/third_party//sodium`, `bearssl`: `/third_party//bearssl`, `openssl`: `/webcpp/hash//openssl`, `botan` (with exceptions only): `/third_party//botan`, `webcrypto` (asynchronous family only): `/webcpp/asio//asio`
| the default
| `example/hkdf_backends.cpp`

| run the same code, with the same results, on every target
| <<hash-default-backend,the default backend, backends::hash2, the same code on every target>>
| `hash2`: `/webcpp/hash//hash`, `sodium`: `/third_party//sodium`, `bearssl`: `/third_party//bearssl`, `openssl`: `/webcpp/hash//openssl`, `botan` (with exceptions only): `/third_party//botan`, `webcrypto` (asynchronous family only): `/webcpp/asio//asio`
| the default
| `example/hkdf_backends.cpp`
|===
